label: The " to" token detector
explanation: This feature fires on essentially every occurrence of the exact token " to" (lowercase with a leading space), which is why its firing rate matches that token's corpus frequency and why the strongest 2,000 firings are all " to". It fires weakly and sporadically on variants like "To"/"to"/" To" and on nearby words after "to" (e.g. "literally", "admitting") as spillover, but not on other prepositions or infinitive markers. The frequent preceding verbs like "need", "want", and "able" simply reflect where "to" ordinarily appears, not a trigger.
